title: Getting started
lede: First-time setup for new course directors.

items.d: Go to [www.examsoft.com/hawaiimed](https://www.examsoft.com/hawaiimed). Use the **Administrators / Faculty** login at the bottom of the page, not the student login at the top.

fig.alt: ExamSoft login page showing two sections: Exam Takers at the top for students, Administrators / Faculty at the bottom for course directors.
fig.caption: Use the bottom login box.

items.d: Open My Preferences from the gear icon, go to the Question Creation tab, set both font fields to Arial 12, then Save.

fig.alt: My Preferences page in ExamSoft showing the Question Creation tab. Question Fonts and Answer Fonts are both set to Arial 12.
fig.caption: Both font fields set to Arial 12, then Save Preferences.

items.d: Find your course's most recent assessment and open it. You will build this year's version from it.

blocks.title: Your draft is due 7 business days before the exam
blocks.text: OME needs the full seven days to proof the assessment, preview it on an iPad, print backup copies, and build proctor materials.
